title: Spiritual Warfare
definition: Spiritual warfare is the believer's struggle against sin, Satan, deception, and spiritual evil through the strength and truth God provides.
summary: Spiritual warfare is standing firm in Christ against evil, lies, temptation, and accusation.
christFocus: Jesus defeated the devil, overcame temptation, and gives His people victory through His Word, Spirit, and finished work.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Spiritual warfare is real, but it must be understood biblically. Believers face the world, the flesh, and the devil. The battle includes deception, temptation, accusation, fear, false teaching, and discouragement.

The weapons God gives are not worldly methods but truth, righteousness, the Gospel, faith, salvation, the Word of God, prayer, and the strength of the Lord.

Christ has already won the decisive victory. Spiritual warfare is not panic; it is faithful resistance under the Lordship of the risen Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Some people ignore spiritual warfare while others become obsessed with fear and speculation. Spiritual warfare matters because it teaches sober watchfulness without losing confidence in Christ's victory.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Stand firm in the Lord. Use Scripture against lies, pray continually, resist temptation quickly, stay in fellowship, and refuse fear-driven obsession with evil.
